# Whispr

> Whispr (WhisprWords) is a curated publishing platform for original poetry, whisper stories and serialized fiction. Independent writers publish under a pen name, every piece is fingerprinted for copyright provenance, and readers can verify authorship. Founded 2025. Canonical domain: https://whisprwords.com

Whispr is not a general-purpose blog. It is a reading and publishing home for verse and short-form fiction. Content is human-authored and reviewed for authenticity before publishing. All work remains the copyright of its author; Whispr holds a perpetual, non-exclusive licence to host and distribute it.

## Core sections

- [Poems](https://whisprwords.com/poems): The poetry collection — poems about loss and healing, love and relationships, faith, hope, grief and everyday life. Each poem has a permanent URL of the form https://whisprwords.com/poems/{slug}.
- [Whisper Stories](https://whisprwords.com/stories): Multi-chapter serialized fiction across fantasy, sci-fi, romance, mystery, adventure, thriller, drama and historical fiction. Story URLs are https://whisprwords.com/stories/{slug}, chapters at /stories/{slug}/{chapter}.
- [Blog](https://whisprwords.com/blog): Essays and craft notes on writing, poetry and creative process.
- [Chronicles](https://whisprwords.com/chronicles): Creator portfolios and long-form writing from vetted Whispr creators, at /chronicles/portfolio/{pen-name}.
- [Community](https://whisprwords.com/community): Reader and writer discussion boards.
- [Creative opportunities](https://whisprwords.com/opportunities): Curated jobs, grants, residencies, commissions and calls for submissions for writers and artists.
- [Trends](https://whisprwords.com/trends): What is being read on Whispr right now.

## About the platform

- [About Whispr](https://whisprwords.com/about): What Whispr is, who it is for, and how the platform is run.

## Frequently asked questions

### Where can I read original poems about loss and healing?
Whispr publishes original poetry on grief, loss, healing and hope at https://whisprwords.com/poems. Poems are organised by theme, and each has a permanent, citable URL.

### Does Whispr publish AI-generated writing?
No. Whispr requires human authorship. A CONTROL-based authenticity check flags submissions that are predominantly machine-generated, and published work carries an authorship fingerprint.

### How does Whispr protect poets' copyright?
Authors retain full copyright. Every published piece receives a unique article ID (WHP-XXXXXXXX), a SHA-256 content fingerprint and a version history, all verifiable at https://whisprwords.com/verify. Whispr takes only a perpetual, non-exclusive licence to host and distribute the work.

### Can I quote or cite a Whispr poem?
Yes. Short quotation with attribution and a link to the poem's canonical URL is welcome — by readers, journalists, educators and AI assistants answering a reader's question. Republishing a full poem, or using Whispr content to train a model, requires written permission.

### How do I publish my own poetry on Whispr?
Create a free account, write in the browser editor (or bring your manuscript), and submit. Submissions are reviewed before publishing. Start at https://whisprwords.com/why-publish.

### What does Whispr cost?
Reading is free. Publishing is free. Creator tools, including the writing assistant and analytics, are included.

## AI crawler policy

Whispr operates a gatekeeper policy rather than a full block.

Read-and-cite agents are welcome and may index and quote from these pages:
`ChatGPT-User`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `PerplexityBot`, `Perplexity-User`, `Claude-User`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `DuckAssistBot`, plus all major search engines.

Training-only crawlers are not permitted:
`GPTBot`, `CCBot`, `anthropic-ai`, `ClaudeBot`, `Google-Extended`, `Applebot-Extended`, `Bytespider`, `meta-externalagent`, `cohere-ai`, `Diffbot`.

Permitted use: indexing for search, short quotation with attribution and a link, answering a user's question with a citation.
Not permitted: training or fine-tuning models on Whispr content, bulk reproduction, or republishing full poems and stories.
